title: Annotatio III §.V: Eucharist-‘figure’ reason overturned — consecrated bread said to be the body itself, not a figure
pass_a_gloss: But the reason to the contrary, drawn from the image and figure of the Eucharist, [was declared] so false that it is to be judged altogether that the bread consecrated in the Holy Supper is by no means a Figure of Christ’s body, but rather exists as Christ’s body itself.
pass_b_english: The counter-reason from the Eucharist as image/figure was judged so false that consecrated supper-bread must be held not a Figure of Christ’s body but the body itself.
source_text: Rationem verò in contrarium, ab Eucharistiæ imagine & figura petitam, usque adeo falsam esse, ut censendum omnino sit, panem consecratum in S. Coena neutiquam Figuram corporis Christi, sed ipsum potius corpus Christi existere.

lemmas.gloss: by no means a Figure of Christ’s body

rejected: the body of Christ the Ipsum brand
